status_vocabulary.implemented: Code path exists and focused automated tests cover its declared behavior.
status_vocabulary.partially_implemented: Some planned capabilities exist; material release requirements remain absent.
status_vocabulary.not_implemented: No executable implementation has been verified.
status_vocabulary.real_world_verified: A permissioned real-world workflow passed the declared acceptance set with recorded evidence and independent review.

release_rule: Unit-test success does not imply real_world_verified. Unsupported or missing evidence must be inconclusive, not pass.
